newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P affirms Tui Milk's ratings, outlook developing.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Tui Milk's ratings, outlook developing.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp on Wednesday affirmed Tui Milk Products Ltd's A long-term and A-1 Commercial Paper ratings following Tui's merger with Kiwi Co-operative Dairies Ltd.
S&P said the rating outlook was developing.
"The larger combined entity should improve Tui's business position and have a positive impact on long-term credit quality.

"However, potential risks associated with the transition process and uncertainty regarding the future financial strategies of the merged entity, particularly the level of milk payments and prudential framework, are negative factors that could adversely impact the ratings," S&P said.
It said the merged entity should provide significant benefits resulting from a stronger market position and operational synergies.
"However, the merger exposes the entity to the normal risks associated with rationalising the manuafacturing plants and product mixes of the two entities."
The combined entity would constitute 25 percent of New Zealand's dairy production, with about 4,000 suppliers.
Critical mass achieved by the merger would enhance the group's ability to take advantage of anticipated increased export demand.
